$comment: Asset index for the Phaser 4 loader. Frame metadata verified against the real PNG headers (cols*frameWidth === imageWidth, rows*frameHeight === imageHeight). 'bounds' are in SOURCE FRAME pixel space with the origin at the frame's top-left. 'visual' was measured as the union of the non-transparent pixel bbox across every frame of the animation. Rewritten by the Character Gym save action.
